findings.title: None score in sector_assignments.json (8 sector(s))
findings.description: Sectors assigned with None scores: ['Technology', 'Financials', 'Cybersecurity', 'Regional Banks', 'Retail', 'Semiconductors', 'Industrials', 'Defense & Aerospace']. Agent assignment decisions based on null scores may produce arbitrary sector priority ordering.
findings.proposed_fix: In rd_team_leader.py: filter out sectors with None scores before ranking. Treat None as score=0 or skip entirely.

findings.title: None canary readings: ['spy_pct']
findings.description: yfinance failed to return data for SPY/VIX indicators: ['spy_pct']. The canary uses these to gate all trading — a None VIX or SPY means the canary may have defaulted to GREEN when the market was actually stressed.
findings.proposed_fix: If SPY or VIX is None, default canary to ORANGE (fail-safe) and log the data gap rather than silently defaulting to GREEN.

findings.title: Stale data file: data/earnings_predictions.json (29h old, threshold 26h)
findings.description: data/earnings_predictions.json has not been updated in 29h. Expected refresh interval: 26h. Data from this file may be leading to decisions based on stale market state.
findings.proposed_fix: Check that the agent producing data/earnings_predictions.json ran successfully in recent logs. Verify its cron schedule is active.

findings.title: yfinance beat_rate coverage restored: 100% of sample tickers
findings.description: yfinance earnings history now available for 5/5 sample tickers. Earnings predictor beat_rate can now be re-enabled. Gap lasted 37 day(s).
findings.proposed_fix: Re-enable beat_rate in earnings_predictor.py and remove the MEDIUM known-gap finding.
